create_fileclient_backend: create a FileClient with a specified storage backend like disk, petrel, or http
read_file_bytes: read binary data from a file path using FileClient get method
read_file_text: read text content from a file path using FileClient get_text method
register_custom_backend: register a custom storage backend class with FileClient using the register_backend decorator
list_dir_or_file: scan a directory and list files or subdirectories using FileClient list_dir_or_file method
